judgments.rationale: The proposal modifies the summary to restrict inspections of records relating to a traced firearm involved in a criminal investigation to 'not more than once during any 12-month period'. Under item (ii)(II) (F004), inspection of such records may occur 'at any time', which is a disjunctive alternative to the 12-month limitation set out in item (ii)(I) (F003). Conflating the two conditions contradicts the statutory text.

The proposal populates the optional action and action_quote fields with 'inspect or examine', which merely copies meaning already fully and accurately expressed in the summary without adding missing legal requirements or fixing any defect.
